invite.title: 360° capture invitation
invite.intro: {host} invites you to upload 360° panoramas for the property {property}.
invite.scope: Accepting only lets you upload to this property, for a limited time — you do not join any office.
invite.identityDeclared: The sender's details are declared, not verified.
invite.signInHint: Use the account with the email address that received this invitation — or create one.
invite.acceptedBody: You can now upload captures for this property.
invite.declinedBody: The sender will see that you declined.
invite.unavailable: We could not complete this right now.

inviteRefusal.linkForeign: This link was issued by a different environment. Ask for a new one.
inviteRefusal.expired: The invitation has expired. Ask the sender for a new one.
inviteRefusal.alreadyUsed: This invitation has already been answered.
inviteRefusal.revoked: The invitation was revoked or replaced by a newer one.
inviteRefusal.wrongRecipient: This invitation is addressed to a different email. Sign in with that account.

refusal.tourAbsent: This listing has no tour yet.
refusal.notRequestable: This tour does not accept requests.
refusal.notManager: You do not manage this listing.
refusal.expiryRequired: Set until when the permission is valid.
refusal.expiryPast: The expiry must be in the future.
refusal.expiryTooFar: The expiry cannot be more than one year away.
refusal.notPending: The request has already been answered.
refusal.notActive: The permission is no longer active.
refusal.reasonRequired: Write what job you are inviting the photographer for.
refusal.tourCustodyMismatch: The listing changed hands — the tour belongs to the previous manager.
refusal.tourUnreadable: The tour cannot be read right now.
refusal.noCaptureGrant: You have no capture permission for this property.
refusal.revoked: Your permission was revoked. Ask for a new invitation.
refusal.expired: Your permission has expired. Ask for a new invitation.
refusal.unreadableExpiry: Your permission cannot be read. Ask for a new invitation.
refusal.scopeMissing: Your permission does not cover uploading.
refusal.notJpeg: The file is not a JPEG.
refusal.tooLarge: The file is larger than 40 MB.
refusal.notEquirect: The image is not a 360° panorama (2:1 ratio).
refusal.tooSmall: The resolution is too low — at least 4096 pixels wide is required.
refusal.ticketInvalid: The upload expired. Start it again.
refusal.ticketForeign: This upload belongs to a different account or property.
refusal.uploadMissing: The file did not arrive. Start the upload again.
refusal.uploadIncomplete: The file was not uploaded completely. Start it again.
refusal.declarationInvalid: Fill in the capture details correctly.
refusal.unavailable: Something went wrong. Try again shortly.

panel.title: 360° tour
panel.description: Invite a photographer or upload panoramas. Panoramas land in the inbox and are placed on the floor plan later.
panel.inviteReasonPlaceholder: e.g. capture before the walls are closed
panel.noCaptures: No panorama has been uploaded yet.
panel.loadFailed: The tour details could not be loaded.

delivery.accepted: The invitation was handed to the email provider.
delivery.unaddressable: The invitation was created, but no email was sent (the public address is missing).
delivery.failed: The invitation was created, but the email was not sent. Try resending.

upload.title: Upload a 360° panorama
upload.creator: Creator
upload.paused: Network interrupted — the upload will continue where it left off.
upload.done: The panorama was uploaded to the inbox.
upload.replayed: This panorama had already been uploaded.
